title: Pip value in your account currency

inOneLine.simple: Pip value tells you how much money one pip is worth on your trade.
inOneLine.balanced: [[pip-value|Pip value]] = units × pip size, in the [[quote-currency]]. If your account uses another currency, convert it at the current rate.

explain.simple: To turn pips into money, multiply your trade size in units by the size of one pip. The answer is in the second currency of the pair. For EUR/USD that is US dollars. If your account is also in US dollars, you are done. If not, you convert the answer into your account currency.
explain.balanced: Pip value = units × pip size, measured in the [[quote-currency]]. If the account currency is the quote currency, no conversion is needed. Otherwise divide or multiply by the exchange rate between the quote currency and the account currency. Because that rate moves, pip value can change a little while a trade is open. Profit or loss = pips moved × pip value.

steps: Trade 1: pip value = 10,000 × 0.0001 = 1 USD per pip. The account is in USD, so no conversion.
Trade 2: pip value = 100,000 × 0.01 = 1,000 JPY per pip.
Convert JPY to USD: 1,000 ÷ 150.00 = 6.666… USD per pip, about 6.67.
A 20-pip move on Trade 2 is 20 × 6.666… = 133.33 USD. Round at the end, not in the middle, or small errors grow.
Pip value in the quote currency = 10,000 × 0.0001 = 1 GBP per pip.
Convert GBP to USD: 1 × 1.2500 = 1.25 USD per pip.

explainSimpler: Size times one pip gives money in the second currency. If your account uses a different currency, change it over at today's rate.
commonMistake: Assuming one pip is always worth 10 USD per lot. That is only true when USD is the quote currency and the account is in USD. For USD/JPY, EUR/GBP or a non-USD account the value is different.

quickCheck.prompt: EUR/USD, 1.00 lot (100,000 EUR), account in USD. What is one pip worth?

options.explanation: No: that is the pip value for 10,000 units (0.10 lot).
Right: 100,000 × 0.0001 = 10 USD, and the account is already in USD.

quickCheck.prompt: USD/JPY at 125.00, 0.10 lot (10,000 USD), account in USD. What is one pip worth?

options.explanation: No: 100 is the pip value in yen. It still needs converting to dollars.
No: that ignores the yen pip size and the conversion.

quickCheck.prompt: Before any conversion, pip value comes out in which currency?

options.explanation: Right: the price is quoted in the second currency, so pip value is too.
No: the size is in the base currency, but price steps are in the quote currency.
No: pip value comes out in the quote currency first. It only matches your account currency when the two are the same, or after converting.

doItNow.instructions: Open the pip value calculator. Work out the pip value in your account currency for EUR/USD, USD/JPY and EUR/GBP at 0.10 lot. Do one by hand first, then check it with the calculator.

homework: Start your list of 10 trades: for each, write the pair, size in lots, account currency, and pip value. You will add margin in the next lesson.
